description: Appends one complete Phase-A fleet-liveness observation to deployment-native StateManagementInterface-backed storage. It records the checked population, structured stuck findings, actions, outcome, coordinator role-inbox drain, host-sleep result, and escalations. Call it on every pass, including a clear pass; empty lists are evidence of no findings, not omitted prose. It is append-only and intentionally non-retryable because an uncertain retry could create a duplicate operational observation.
embedding_description: Persist one complete structured Phase-A fleet-liveness observation in deployment-native state, including the checked population, stuck findings, recovery actions, coordinator inbox-drain result, host-sleep check, and any escalations, without editing an append-only workbench markdown log.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: {"status": "recorded"} means one append-only structured run record was written.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Routine clear-path success needs no narration; surface the record's factual findings and escalations, not a claim inferred from a write receipt.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One StateManagementInterface append to the deployment's fleet_liveness_run table; no project-solet register access and no filesystem write.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument or invalid_argument means the caller did not provide a complete structured pass. state_service_unavailable means deployment-native persistence is unavailable; do not substitute a markdown log.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Fix the structured payload before retrying a validation failure. For an uncertain transport failure after a write attempt, query recent runs before deciding whether a new pass record is warranted.
